content.premise: The keep's last warden has stopped speaking to travellers who do not look. A lever at his empty stand by the gate, a bell in a side room, a gatehouse that keeps whoever passes, and a great hall he has withdrawn to — the keep answers what you do, and only that.
content.theme: A small stone keep that tells you almost nothing: no marker over the thing to pull, one line for the bell, nothing else on screen but the room.
content.title: The Quiet Room
